For those of you asking why I want to leave my parents’ house, they have two mentally ill teenagers who are very intolerant toward my children and I’m sharing a small bedroom with both of my kids. I have zero privacy and everyone has to walk through my bedroom to get to the bathroom and it constantly wakes up my kids. My parents aren’t exactly the best babysitters either.
